description: Both Anthropic and OpenAI telemetry handlers delegate to TelemetryLogger, which only logs events as [telemetry] name key: value to Logger.info when enabled. The token counts (input_tokens, output_tokens, total_tokens) are emitted but never consumed for any downstream purpose — no cost tracking, no compaction decisions, no dashboards.\n\nFix: Either build a proper telemetry consumer (e.g. a cost aggregator or stats collector) or remove the dead telemetry emission code. At minimum, ensure the token data flows somewhere useful.
title: Act on AI telemetry token counts instead of just logging them
